historical_significance: 徐光启（1562-1633），字子先，号玄扈，南直隶松江府上海县人，明朝末年数学家、科学家、政治家、翻译家。他将欧几里得《几何原本》译成中文，并将西方科学技术引入中国，是中西文化交流的先驱之一。他的著作和实践涵盖数学、水利、农学、军事学等多个领域，对明清之际的知识体系转型产生了深远影响。
historical_significance_en: Xu Guangqi (1562-1633), courtesy name Zixiang, hao Xuangu, Christian name Paul, from Shanghai County, Jiangsu province. Late Ming mathematician, scientist, politician and translator who translated Euclid's Elements into Chinese and introduced Western science and technology to China, becoming one of the pioneers of cultural exchange between China and the West. His writings and practices covered mathematics, hydraulics, agriculture and military science, having a profound impact on the knowledge system transition in the late Ming to early Qing period.
key_quotes_zh: “博求道艺之士，虚心扬榷，令彼三千年增修渐进之业，我岁月间拱受其成”。
key_quotes_en: "."The most valuable knowledge comes from personal experience."
